verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's CLI documents a `debug-files upload` command for native debug symbols (dSYM, PDB, ELF), which covers the iOS and native parts of the story. ProGuard mappings for Android are never mentioned. The docs also don't describe how the uploaded symbols turn crashes into function names and line numbers. Missing for 10: ProGuard/R8 mapping upload, documentation of the symbolication process and results, independent or hands-on confirmation that mobile/native crashes symbolicate correctly.
